create_zip_name: create a zip file name for library documentation artifacts with optional extension
merge_with_existing_docs: merge newly built documentation with existing docs to preserve all languages across parallel builds
push_command_add: zip documentation artifacts and upload them to a Hugging Face dataset repo with retry logic
push_command_remove: delete a documentation version zip file from a Hugging Face dataset repo with retry logic
push_command_parser: build an argparse CLI parser for the doc-builder push command with library and repo arguments
